name: mashumaro-structured-deserialization-error-paths
instr:
Add opt-in structured deserialization errors so callers can identify the exact input location of failures throughout typed decoding without reproducing mashumaro's traversal. Paths must remain stable and machine-readable across nested dataclasses, containers, unions, discriminators, and codec entry points. Existing behavior remains unchanged unless detailed errors are enabled.

`DeserializationPath`, `FieldSegment`, `IndexSegment`, `KeySegment`, and `RootSegment` from `mashumaro.error_paths` form an immutable ordered path whose `render` method produces deterministic JSONPath with unambiguous escaping; `FieldSegment(name)`, `IndexSegment(index)`, and `RootSegment(name='$')` are frozen values. A `DetailedDeserializationError` from `mashumaro.exceptions` retains the rejected value, innermost declared type, original exception as its direct cause, and one composed path rather than accumulating wrappers. Every generated typed boundary adds exactly one segment for the external field key actually consumed, whether selected by metadata, `Annotated`, configuration alias, or name fallback, or for the collection position, mapping key, discriminator, or codec root; missing input retains `MissingField`, hook failures remain distinct, and existing detailed failures are extended rather than rewrapped.
